assessments.reasoning: The Python Software Foundation publishes this section or implementation file in the exact CPython v3.13.0 source revision. Fresh direct acquisition matches the registered source SHA-256 43287e5746ee0de7cd01a855157ebb5a35bb93cd36d77e0553175c186a6066a1. The nonlocal visitor marks DEF_NONLOCAL, the nonlocal analyzer marks a visible eligible name FREE, and a class block explicitly inserts __class__ into the visible binding set handed to child blocks. CPython 3.13.0's symbol-table implementation can classify a method's nonlocal __class__ name as a free variable through its enclosing class's implicit binding, even with no enclosing function assignment. An ordinary method is defined directly in a module-level class and has an otherwise valid nonlocal __class__ declaration without an ordinary enclosing function assignment. This records the pinned implementation's symbol-table classification. It does not generalize it to arbitrary classes, runtime cell customization, or other Python implementations. Ordinary class bindings are not propagated in the same way. The exact implementation contains a special case for __class__. A local CPython 3.13.5 example observed the method free-variable entry; this is a corroborating adjacent-version probe only.
